page.title: Senior FullStack Engineer Backend Specialist
page.desc: I craft scalable, high-performing, and secure backend solutions, ensuring seamless integration.

about_me.description1: I'm a senior FullStack developer, specializing in the backend, with solid experience in creating robust, scalable systems. My aim is to help you realize your projects by designing high-performance, secure APIs tailored to your specific needs, while guaranteeing seamless integration with your front-end.
about_me.description2: Thanks to my expertise in Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript, I can help you develop backend solutions that are efficient, easy to maintain and in line with your objectives. I also master front-end development with React and Next.js, enabling me to offer complete and perfectly integrated solutions.
about_me.description3: I always work with a focus on quality, with clear, structured code and an emphasis on best practices. Together, we can transform your ideas into high-performance tools aligned with your ambitions.
